versions.subject: rule: two rules to detect CVE-2020-0688 exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    cs-method: 'GET'
    c-uri|contains:
        - '/ecp/'
        - '/owa/'
    c-uri|contains: '__VIEWSTATE=' 
condition: selection
